# ECDcoding

> ECDcoding empowers tech-savvy kids in South Africa with CAPS-aligned coding, robotics and early-childhood lessons for ages 4–12.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of ECDcoding and entry points to age-grouped lesson vaults.
- [Register](/register): Sign up as a Parent, ECD Manager or Tech Teacher.
- [Sign in](/sign-in): Existing user sign-in.
- [ECD Coding & Robotics Expo 2026](/ecd-expo-2026): Event page for the June 2026 expo at Nasrec, Soweto — sponsors, exhibitors, speakers and delegates.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How user data is handled.
- [Data Deletion](/data-deletion): How to request account and data removal.
